page_title: STR 2-1 LIL | Strasbourg v Lille 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' One of the players from Lille times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Lille.
90+3' Angel Gomes (Lille) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+3' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90+2' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Diego Moreira and he is replaced by Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mohamed Bayo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Aaron Malouda (Lille).
88' Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
87' Remy Cabella (Lille) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) comes onto the pitch for Emanuel Emegha.
86' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Ethan Mbappe (Lille) replaces Ayyoub Bouaddi.
85' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier is equal to it and makes an easy save.
82' Remy Cabella (Lille) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Angel Gomes (Lille) will replace Mitchel Bakker.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Osame Sahraoui leaves the pitch and Remy Cabella (Lille) comes on.
80' Liam Rosenior decides to make a substitution. Felix Lemarechal will be replaced by Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg).
79' A substitution has been made. Abdoul Ouattara is replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
76' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.

76' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Lucas Chevalier dived superbly to block a header by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Lucas Chevalier pulled off a remarkable save!

74' 2 - 1 Habib Diarra showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 2:1.
72' Lille fail to score from a corner as Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) leaps to collect the ball.

72' Mohamed Bayo (Lille) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Djordje Petrovic anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Lille have a corner.

70' 1 - 1 Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:1.
70' Benjamin Andre (Lille) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
69' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
67' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Today's referee Willy Delajod rightly decides to book Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) for his harsh tackle.
65' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
62' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
60' A corner kick by Strasbourg is thwarted by the well prepared Lucas Chevalier (Lille).

59' Close! Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out. The ball goes out of play. Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.

57' What a save from Lucas Chevalier! Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
55' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Good work from Strasbourg as they win a corner.
54' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
53' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

53' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Lille fail to score from a corner as Djordje Petrovic (Strasbourg) leaps to collect the ball.

49' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Djordje Petrovic was alert and the score remains the same. Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' Willy Delajod interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg).
47' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is adjudged offside.
46' Liam Rosenior makes a switch. Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) is coming on in place of Sebastian Nanasi at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' NO PENALTY! Referee Willy Delajod has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Lille players are incensed.
45+3' Celebrations by Lille are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
45+2' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Lille are awarded a penalty kick!
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Mamadou Sarr (Strasbourg) is penalised for holding. Willy Delajod signals a set piece.
41' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
40' The linesman raises his flag. Thomas Meunier (Lille) is adjudged offside.
39' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the right-hand post, but the goalkeeper stretches to stop it.
39' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Strasbourg get a corner.
37' The free kick is taken by Mitchel Bakker (Lille), but ball is cleared.
37' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Willy Delajod ignores the protests.
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diego Moreira (Strasbourg). Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
33' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) has received a yellow card for his foul.
31' Some neat passing and movement from Strasbourg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
29' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
27' A clever short pass gives Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
26' 41:59 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
24' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
21' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
19' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) sees a yellow card from Willy Delajod after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
17' Aissa Mandi (Lille) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
17' Lille take a short corner kick.

17' A sweet pass finds Thomas Meunier (Lille) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the roof of the net. Djordje Petrovic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
14' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
11' Dangerous play by Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg). Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
8' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Osame Sahraoui (Lille), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
8' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
7' The ball is cleared after Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Strasbourg.
5' Thomas Meunier (Lille) was too forceful with his tackle and Willy Delajod interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

4' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Lucas Chevalier is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
2' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) takes the corner but it's cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
